The Standard Spec

Every unit in the Ironwood Collective is finished to the same "Scholar-Grade" standard. We do not upsell "Premium Views" or "Upgraded Packages." Excellence is the baseline.

Domestic Infrastructure

In-Unit Laundry

Full-Size GE Profile™ Washer & Dryer. No coin-ops. No hauling baskets down the stairs. Do your laundry while you study.

Chef's Kitchen

Full-size dishwasher, garbage disposal, and 30-inch glass-top range. Granite countertops are standard because they are durable and easy to clean.

Private Outdoor Space

Every unit features a dedicated concrete balcony or ground-floor patio. Perfect for a caffeine break or reading in natural light.

The Scholar's Edge

Features specifically designed for focus, sleep, and connectivity.

Hardwired Ethernet (Cat6)

Wi-Fi is great, but latency kills focus. Every single bedroom and the living room features dedicated RJ45 Data Ports connected directly to the Stardust Fiber node. Perfect for server labs, gaming, or large CAD transfers.

Solid-Core Bedroom Doors

Most apartments use cheap, hollow doors that block zero noise. We install heavy, solid-core pine doors with commercial hinges. When you shut your door, the rest of the apartment disappears.

Integrated Blackout Shades

Sleep is critical for memory retention. Every bedroom window comes pre-installed with heavy-duty roller blackout shades. Whether you nap at 2 PM or sleep until noon, you control the light.

HVAC with HEPA Filtration

Aligning with our "Smoke-Free" policy, our HVAC systems are fitted with MERV-13 or higher filters to reduce allergens, pollen, and dust. Breathe easy.

Note on Furnishings: Unless otherwise noted in your specific lease addendum, units are leased unfurnished to allow you to build your own environment.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
